provenance_warning: This document reconstructs the declared design and operational settings after execution. It is not a pre-execution immutable specification and does not satisfy the future-C2 specification gate.
research_question: How can a single primitive relational condition remain invariant while richer structures become admissible as domain degrees of freedom increase, and does every genuine projection between distinct domains necessarily generate residue?
null_hypothesis: No coherent domain-relative primitive hierarchy exists, and at least one admissible cross-domain projection can have zero residue under each non-definitional residue criterion.
experimental_hypothesis: The core primitive remains invariant across declared domains, while every genuine cross-domain projection generates positive residue under an appropriately operationalized residue criterion.

independent_variables.name: source_domain
independent_variables.definition: Declared source domain of the finite relational organization.

independent_variables.name: target_domain
independent_variables.definition: Declared target domain of the finite relational organization.

independent_variables.name: admissibility_class
independent_variables.definition: Weak total-map admissibility versus conservative coverage/reference/orientation/relation-preserving admissibility.

independent_variables.name: residue_criterion
independent_variables.definition: Operational residue criterion used to test the universal hypothesis.

controls: Binary orientation labels, undirected relational edges, optional reference member, and declared domain type are explicit model fields.
Weak and strong admissibility are reported separately.
The target safety threshold is 500; oversized target blocks use deterministic stratified enumeration recorded in the run manifest.
The falsification rule is fixed before interpretation: one admissible zero-residue cross-domain projection falsifies the universal claim for that criterion and model class.
Typed residue is reported separately because domain mismatch contributes directly to it.
termination_conditions: Enumerate all declared finite blocks and total maps, subject to deterministic target stratification above the safety threshold.
Stop after all weak and strong admissible records are evaluated.
Export counterexamples rather than suppressing them.
Mark typed residue as definition-dependent in interpretation.
interpretation_protocol: A single zero-residue admissible projection falsifies the universal residue claim only for the tested criterion and finite model class.
A surviving criterion is not a theorem or proof outside the tested model class.
Typed residue must be labeled partly definitional because domain mismatch contributes directly.
Preserve non-identifiability, counterexamples, bounded enumeration, and stratified-block limitations.
Cap the result at C2 bounded notebook output with limitations.
